Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:equip_access_privs.eff_date, 'MM-DD-YY');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 if (:equip_access_privs.eff_date is null) then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- IM 402
 
 if (:SYSTEM.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED')) then
 if (:equip_access_privs.eff_date < trunc(chp_sysdate)) then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if (:equip_access_privs.eff_date > nvl (:equip_access_privs.term_date, :equip_access_privs.eff_date)) then
 show_error ('1316');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 check_package_failure;

 end loop;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUP_EAP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_dup_eap IS
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 :GLOBAL.equip_type := :equip_access_privs.equip_type;
 :GLOBAL.fcn_grp := :equip_access_privs.fcn_grp;
 go_record ('1');
 while (:SYSTEM.last_record != 'TRUE') loop
 if ((:equip_access_privs.equip_type = :GLOBAL.equip_type) and
 (:equip_access_privs.fcn_grp = :GLOBAL.fcn_grp) and
 (:SYSTEM.cursor_record != :GLOBAL.cursor_record)) then
 show_error ('1324');
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 down;
 end loop;
--
 if ((:equip_access_privs.equip_type = :GLOBAL.equip_type) and
 (:equip_access_privs.fcn_grp = :GLOBAL.fcn_grp) and
 (:SYSTEM.cursor_record != :GLOBAL.cursor_record)) then
 show_error ('1324');
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
--
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
END;
